description: The single asset manifest for next-r3f-cinematic. Every runtime asset is listed here; the scene loads only committed local files and renders offline.

assets.purpose: Header brand mark, rendered in the server HTML.
Desktop poster fallback: a capture of this scene from the hero-wide station, sized to the frame a desktop and tablet layout gives it. Regenerate with `npm run capture:poster`.
Portrait poster fallback: a capture of this scene from the hero-portrait station, sized square to match the near-square frame a portrait phone gives it. Regenerate with `npm run capture:poster`.
The optimized procedural-crystal GLB produced by the existing inspect/validate/optimize handoff; it uses the local Draco decoder.
Poly Haven Studio Small 08 1k environment for restrained crystal reflections; copied from website-design-ultra/templates/assets/.
Local Draco WASM decoder for the manifest-declared crystal model.
Local Draco decoder wrapper for the manifest-declared crystal model.
Local Draco JavaScript fallback decoder for the manifest-declared crystal model.
